bundle.shortDescription: Synology shared folders over SFTP on Linux and Windows
bundle.longDescription: Guided setup of SFTP mounts for Synology NAS: SSH key, pinned host key, mounts at sign-in, reconnect after suspend and network changes, LAN and internet addresses, a self-test of what each folder can do, and an administrator area for account access. Linux uses sshfs, Windows rclone and WinFsp. Independent community project, not affiliated with Synology Inc.
